I have digged, and drunk water/I dried up all the Nile of Egypt. Sennacherib boasts of his power to produce water-or to dry it up, symbolizing his confidence in his ability to conquer Egypt. As one commentator notes, "The king's foot is equal to blocking even the Nile itself!

places parched up, looking as though there had been no water or rain from heaven for many years. The "remnant" that went forth "out of Jerusalem" at the time of the Assyrian siege of Jerusalem could have been one of the "graftings" mentioned by the prophet Zenos as recorded in the Book of Mormon. (See Jacob 5:8, 13, 14, 20-28)
